subparts.solution: No, the relationship is more likely dependent on the amount of professional experience or qualifications an individual has.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Correlation does not imply causation; confounding variables like experience often drive the association.
step_by_step: Consider whether growing older directly causes someone's salary to increase automatically.
